**Event:** Methods workshop, University of Bamberg\
**Location:** University of Bamberg, Germany

## Context

Latent profile analysis groups people by their pattern of scores rather than splitting a
sample on one variable at a time. This workshop covered when a person-centered approach is
warranted, how to choose the number of profiles without over-fitting, and how to run and
report the analysis in R.
